nodes.label: ADR-001 — FastAPI all-in (abandono do Django na reescrita)
Decision: rewrite with FastAPI all-in + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, no Django
nodes.rationale: System gravity is persistent async I/O (OPC-UA), MPC control loops, realtime WebSocket and hypertables — exactly where Django is weakest (partial async ORM, fragile Channels). RBAC is trivial (2 roles) so django-admin is not worth keeping; cost: CRUD UIs must be built in React.
